paite: Huan, Rakil in Jakob ta himhim a neihsak kei chih a kitheih in a sanggam nu a haja ta a; huan, Jakob kiangah, tate hon pia in, huchilouin jaw ka si ding, achia.
english: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”

paite: Huan, Rakil tungah Jakob a heh guih a: huchiin, na gila gah phallou Pathian sik a ka hi ahia? Achia.
english: Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”

paite: Huan, aman, enin, ka sikha nu Bilha, amah kithuahpih in; huchiin ken leng amah a kipan a tate ka neihsam theih na dingin ka phei tungah ta honnei ding ahi, achia.
english: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”

paite: Huchiin, a sikha nu Bilha a ji dingin a pia a: huan, Jakob in amah ana kithuahpih a.
english: She gave him Bilhah her handmaid as wife, and Jacob went in to her.

paite: Huan, Bilha a gai a Jakob ta a neihsak ta.
english: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

paite: Huan, Rakil in, Pathian in a hon ngaihtuah a ka aw leng a ja a, tapa honpia ahi, achi: huaijaikin amin dingin Dan a sa a.
english: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore called she his name Dan.

paite: Huan, Rakil sikha nu Bilha a gai nawna, Jakob tapa dang a neihsak nawn a.
english: Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

paite: Huan, Rakil in Pathian buan in ka sanggam nu ka buan a ka jouta, achia: huchiin a min dingin Napthtali a sa a.
english: Rachel said, “With mighty wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.

paite: Huan, Lea in ta dang anei nawn tadih kei lai chih a kitheih in, a sikha nu Zilpa a pia a ji dingin Jakob kiangah a pia hi.
english: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her handmaid, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

paite: Huchiin, Lea sikha nu Zilpa in Jakob tapa a neihsak a.
english: Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid, bore Jacob a son.

paite: Huan, Lea in vangphat huai mah ei achia: huchiin amin dingin Gad a sa a.
english: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.

paite: Huan, Lea sikha nu Zilpa in Jakob tapa dang a neihsak nawn a.
english: Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid, bore Jacob a second son.

paite: Huan, Lea in, hampha natel ing e! Numei ten hampha hon chiding uh eive, achia: huchiin amin dingin Aser a sa hi.
english: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.

paite: Huan, a buh lak laiin Reuben in jawl ai gamlak ah ava mu a; anu Lea kiangah hon tawi a. Huchiin, Rakil in Lea kiangah, hehpihtak in na tapa jawlai a khen honpe dih ve, achia.
english: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”

paite: Huan, aman, ka kiangah, ka pasal non suh thil duai ahi hia? ka tapa jawl ai leng hon suh na tum nawn lai maw? Achia. Huan, Rakil in, ahihkeileh, n tapa jawl ai sikin tu jan in a hon lupih ding achia.
english: She said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”

paite: Huan, nitaklam in Jakob gamlak a kipan hong tunga, huan Lea a dawn dingin a kuan a, non kithuahpih ding ahi; ka tapa jawl ai in kon khel ta ngal a achia. Huchiin, huai jan in a lupih ta hi.
english: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.

paite: Huan, Pathian in Lea thumna a ngaikhia a, huchiin a gaia, Jakob tapa ngana a neihsak nawna.
english: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

paite: Huan, Lea in, ka sikha nu ka pasal kianga ka piak jiakin Pathianin ka loh honpia eive, achia; huchiin a min dingin Essakar a sa hi.
english: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my handmaid to my husband.” She named him Issachar.

paite: Huan, Lea a gai nawna, Jakob tapa gukna a neihsak nawna.
english: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.

paite: Huan, Lea in, Pathianin van hoih tak a hon neisak a; tuin jaw ka pasal, tapa guk ka neihsak tak jiakin, ka kiangah a teng ta ding, achia: huchiin, amin dingin Zebulun a sa a.
english: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.

paite: Huan, huai nungin tanu a nei nawna, amin dingin Dina a sa hi.
english: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.

paite: Huan, Pathianin Rakil a theigige a, huchiin Pathianin a thumna a ngaikhia a, a sul a honsak hi.
english: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.

paite: Huchiin a gaia, tapa a neia: Pathianin ka minsia a la mang, achia:
english: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”

paite: Huan, Toupan tapa dang honpiak beh hen, chiin, a min dingin Joseph a sa hi.
english: She named him Joseph, Joseph means “may he add.” saying, “May Yahweh add another son to me.”

paite: Huan, hichi ahia, Rakil in Joseph a neih nungin Jakob in, Laban kiangah, kei ka omna ngei ah, ka gam lam ua ka pai na dingin hon paisak ta in aw.
english: It happened, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.

paite: Na na ka sep san ka jite leh ka tate honpia inla, hon paisakin: na na kon sepsak dan leh na thei ngala, achia.
english: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”

paite: Huan, Laban in, a kiangah, na honhehpih theih leh, om tadih lai ve: Toupan nang vangin a honvualjawl chih aisan in ka thei hi, achia.
english: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me for your sake.”

paite: Huan, amah mahin, na loh ding sep inla, honhilh dih, huchiin ka honpe ding hi, achia.
english: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”

paite: Huan, aman, a kiangah, bangchin na na ka sema, bangchin na gan ka kiangah a om ua na thei akei hiam.
english: He said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.

paite: Ka hong main tawm chik kia na neia, tuin jaw tampi a hong phata uhi; ka kalsuanna lam peuh ah Toupan nang a honvualjawl jel hi: Ahihhangin chik chiangin ahia kei inkuante adia ka sep khiak sam ding? Achia.
english: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. Yahweh has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”

paite: Huan, aman, bang ka hon pe dia? Achia. Huan, Jakobin, bangmah na honpiak ding ahi kei: Hiai thil na hon hihsak leh na gan hon ka khah dia ka ching nawn ding.
english: He said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.

paite: Tuniin na gan hon ka va enkhe vek dia, belam laka a vom gial petmah a gial leh a voma gial zekzek leh a vom peuhmah, kel laka a kanga gial petmah a gial leh a kanga gial zekzek te huaia kipan ka pi tuam jel dinga: huan, tuban huchibanga hong piang peuhmah ka loh ding ahi takei dia leh.
english: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.

paite: Huchiin, tuban, na mit muha khelha ka omna thuah na hongpai hun chiangin, ka diktatna in a hondawnsak mai ding: kel laka a kanga gial petmah a gial lou leh, a kanga gial zekzek lou leh, belam laka a vom lou ka kianga na muh peuhpeuh ka guk in na sep mai ding ahi, achia.
english: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be counted stolen.”

paite: Huan, Labanin, ngaiin, na gen bang tak hile ake, achia.
english: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”

paite: Huchiin, huai nitak in kel tal a kanga gial tan leh a kanga gial zekzek teng leh, kelnu a kanga gial petmah a gial leh a kanga gial zekzek teng a kanna om peuhmah, belam, belam laka a vom tengteng toh a pi tuama, a tapate khut ah a pia a;
english: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

paite: Huan, amah leh Jakob kalah ni thum lam a om saka; huan, Jakobin Laban ganhon dang tengteng a khah nawnta.
english: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

paite: Huan, Jakobin hiangjau sing leh makha sing leh sesing chiang hing a laa, a hawng a khok ngou chiata, chiangte ah a ngoute a kilangsaka.
english: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

paite: Huan, achiang hawng khohte gan honten, a hong dawn jelna tuikuangte ah, tui luannate ah, gan honte ma jawn jelah a koihta; huan, tui dawn dinga a hongpai chiang ua a gaina ding un.
english: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the gutters in the watering-troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.

paite: Huchiin, ganhonte chiang jawnah a gai panta ua, a gial tante, gial petmah a gialte, a gial zekzek te a honnei jel uh.
english: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.

paite: Huan, Jakob in belamnou te khawng a koih tuma, huan, ganhonte Laban gan hon laka a gial tan leh a vom tengteng lam a ngasak jela; amah gan honte a koih tuam jela, Laban gan lakah a koih kei.
english: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in the flock of Laban: and he put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.

paite: Huan, hichi ahi a, gan hat deuhte a hong gai pat peuh chiang un chiang laka a gai pat theihna ding un, Jakob in tui luanna ah, gan mitmuhin, chiangte a koih jela;
english: It happened, whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the flock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods;

paite: Ahihhangin gan a hat kei leh, a koih kei jel: huchiin a nou hat lou deuhte jaw Laban a ahi jela, a hat deuhta bel Jakob a ahi jel hi.Huchiin, Jakob nakpiin a hongpung a, ganhon hon thupi tak, sikhanute, sikhapate, sangawngsaute, sabengtungte a neita hi.
english: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

paite: Huchiin, Jakob nakpiin a hongpung a, ganhon hon thupi tak, sikhanute, sikhapate, sangawngsaute, sabengtungte a neita hi.
english: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
